about: Everything the measured dealers do, cut into pieces and sorted into kinds, written by verktyg/rorelser.py. One catalogue per style (data/stil-<style>.json), not per person. from and to are seconds of the film, from_frame and to_frame its frames (60 a second). L and R are the dealer's own left and right; seats are 1 to 7 from the picture's left, the dealer's right. Places: shoe, box (for used cards), own cards (in front of him), toward the shoe and toward the box (the felt beside his own cards), seat N (the players' cards), behind the edge (off the felt, at his body). clean says whether the piece is measured well enough to draw from. Built on the hands, not the card: which side of a card is up, and the turning of his own card, are not told apart here. Kinds: card from the shoe to a seat (the left hand pulls it, the right hand lays it); card from the shoe, left hand alone (his own cards in the rounds checked by eye, and also any card whose laying by the right hand was not found, so its count is too high and the seats' too low); cards into the box (the right hand lifted to the box's opening); waiting (both hands still 1.5 s or more); the other kinds are named after where the hands go and are not yet checked by eye.
